title: Domain property of the localized normalization stalk
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian, U an open, p:P -> U finite etale, x a normalization point outside U, and O_{X,s} a domain and DVR. Then the normalization stalk at x is a domain.

proof.text: Put f = p composed with the open immersion U -> X and s = f.fromNormalization(x). Let A = O(X,s), a0 = X.fromSpecStalk(s), L = X times_X Spec A (using the identity of X), and a = pullback.fst(id_X,a0). The second projection d identifies L with Spec A. The DVR A is an integrally closed domain. Each stalk of Spec A is a prime localization, hence an integrally closed domain. Transport across d to show that L is integral with integrally closed stalks. These are the canonical stalk localization maps; no noncanonical algebraic object is chosen.

Let g = pullback.snd(f,a). Since f is etale, g is smooth. On affine smooth charts over the integral normal L, the base section ring is an integrally closed domain by Scheme.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk. Apply RingHom.Smooth.isNormalRing and transport normal prime localizations of the source chart section ring to source stalks via IsLocalization.algEquiv. This proves that every source stalk of g is a normal domain. The source is locally Noetherian because g is locally of finite type over L.

Apply relativeNormalization_normal_stalks to g to conclude that g.normalization has domain stalks. Apply Hom.isIso_normalizationPullback_stalk to id_X, f and s: its comparison e identifies g.normalization with N times_X L, where N = f.normalization.

The canonical map Spec O(N,x) -> N and Spec of the stalk map of f.fromNormalization give a map into N times_X L by two pullback lifts. The closed point maps to a point y with first projection x. Let z = e.inv(y). Transport the domain property of O(g.normalization,z) through the isomorphism e to O(N times_X L,y). The first projection N times_X L -> N is flat, since it is a base change of a, which is a base change of the flat canonical stalk morphism a0. Its stalk map at y is a flat local ring map, hence faithfully flat and injective. Domainhood descends along this injection, giving IsDomain O(N,x). No preimmersion or surjectivity of stalk maps is needed. The outside-U hypothesis is retained but unused.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_dvr_normalization_stalk_isDomain
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (U : X.Opens)
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite p] (hetale : Etale p)
    (x : (p ≫ U.ι).normalization)
    (hs : (p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x ∉ U)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))] :
    IsDomain ((p ≫ U.ι).normalization.presheaf.stalk x)
